findings: During first service startup Windows requested a manual restart from the Microsoft inbox audio driver refresh. The gateway therefore did not start.
Installer waited for readiness, then removed the just-created service. Its suppressed ssPostInstall exception nevertheless produced exit code 0.
The acceptance helper subsequently failed its first health fetch; this was not a network or ToDesk diagnosis. Uninstall completed and runtime data was preserved.
fix: Run configured endpoint preparation through the same native audio operation before service registration, within the existing elevated installer.
Propagate a typed manual-restart outcome from device preparation. Retain automatic service registration and return 3010 without claiming readiness or rebooting automatically.
Do not classify a failed native provider cleanup as restart-only success.
Return nonzero when post-install work has not completed, including suppressed exceptions.
Require the native audio preparation capability in the bundled control inventory before building an installer.

local_checks.fixture_scope: Official Inno 7.1.1 compiled the actual production exit-code handler. Private non-admin fixtures changed no services, drivers, registry entries or application files.

remaining: Build and accept a matching replacement installer; do not promote the failed 928c012a Windows installer. No local Windows runtime, TLS trust or ToDesk changes were made.
